entities.name: Hans Thomas Lange Schaanning
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans Thomas Lange Schaanning was a Norwegian zoologist and ornithologist who studied the birds on the border of Norway and Russia. He later served as curator of birds in the museum at Stavanger.
